note: Narasi video bounty Chainlink (CreDemo). Format sama dengan narration-pitch.json. Buat ulang: KOKORO_DIR=... uv run -p 3.12 --with kokoro-onnx --with soundfile gen-voice.py src/cre/narration-cre.json

phrases.text: MoveMarket. Live prediction markets on every move of a chess game.
phrases.tts: Move Market. Live prediction markets, on every move of a chess game.

phrases.text: Final results come from Chainlink CRE.
phrases.tts: And the final results... come from Chainlink C.R.E.

phrases.text: Here's a real market on Monad testnet: any check in plies 85 to 88?
phrases.tts: Here's a real market on Moh-nad test net. Any check, in plies eighty-five to eighty-eight?

phrases.text: Our resolver can't choose the answer. It can only ask.
It calls requestResolution, and LiveMarket emits ResolutionRequested.
phrases.tts: It calls request resolution, and Live Market emits, resolution requested.

phrases.text: The workflow is TypeScript, compiled to WebAssembly by the CRE CLI.
phrases.tts: The workflow is TypeScript, compiled to Web Assembly by the C.R.E. C.L.I.

phrases.text: We run the simulator in listen mode, against the live chain.
The request lands on-chain, and the EVM log trigger fires.
phrases.tts: The request lands on chain, and the E.V.M. log trigger fires.

phrases.text: Local simulation: market 441 resolves to NO.
phrases.tts: Local simulation: market four forty-one... resolves to NO.

phrases.text: Now the staging target, with engine logs.
callContract reads getMarkets at the last finalized block.
phrases.tts: Call contract reads, get markets, at the last finalized block.

phrases.text: The HTTP capability fetches the game export from Lichess.
phrases.tts: The H.T.T.P. capability fetches the game export from lee chess.

phrases.text: resolve() is the same shared file our resolver uses, running inside QuickJS WASM.
phrases.tts: Resolve is the same shared file our resolver uses, running inside a Quick J.S. wasm runtime.

phrases.text: Identical-aggregation consensus agrees: 441, NO.
phrases.tts: Identical aggregation consensus agrees. Four forty-one, NO.

phrases.text: The report is ABI-encoded: game key, IDs, outcomes.
phrases.tts: The report is A.B.I. encoded. Game key, I.D.s, outcomes.

phrases.text: writeReport targets LiveMarket onReport. Dry run, nothing broadcast, and it succeeds.
phrases.tts: Write report targets Live Market, on report. Dry run, nothing broadcast... and it succeeds.

phrases.text: The write path is proven on-chain too.
Simulate with broadcast sent a real report through Chainlink's MockKeystoneForwarder.
phrases.tts: Simulate with broadcast, sent a real report through Chainlink's mock Keystone forwarder.

phrases.text: onReport ran, and MarketResolved fired.
phrases.tts: The on-report function ran, and market resolved fired.

phrases.text: onReport only accepts the forwarder. An admin can void a market, but never pick a winner.
phrases.tts: And on-report only accepts the forwarder. An admin can void a market... but never pick a winner.
